'''Waudok''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] fighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] stationed onboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']]. Waudok was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the months leading up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The Rebel was honored at a funeral service along with fellow pilots [[Blue Eight (Defiance)|Blue Eight]], [[Smithy]], [[Roanda]] and [[Voxx]].
